description: Git keeps a history of changes to files. It helps you compare versions and work on ideas without losing the story of how a project grew. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
learningObjectives: Practise try an idea on a branch

seo.title: Git Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Git with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
